biotools.summary: ULaMDyn is a Python-based, open-source package designed to automate the unsupervised analysis of large datasets generated by nonadiabatic molecular dynamics (NAMD) simulations. It streamlines the analysis of excited-state dynamics by employing dimensionality reduction and clustering techniques.
